item.title: Building Permit Application Revised
item.description:
August 11, 2025

NOTICE:  Building Permit Application revised

The Department of Building and Zoning Services revised the Building Permit Application to delete outdated information and provide more detailed information for our customers.  The Building Permit Application is completed and submitted with paper plans to Building and Zoning Services for review. All BZS applications are available in the Documents and Forms section of our website columbus.gov/bzs. Completion of the Building Permit Application is not required if applying for permits through the Citizen Access Portal.

Effective Tuesday September 2nd, 2025, previous versions of the Building Permit Application will no longer be accepted.

Please note that most permits can be applied for through the Citizen Access Portal.  Visit portal.columbus.gov for all online services.

###

item.title: SECURITY CHANGES AT COLEMAN GOVERNMENT BUILDING
item.description:
SECURITY CHANGES AT COLEMAN GOVERNMENT BUILDING

Beginning March 31, 2025, visitors will be required to check-in at 111 N. Front Street.  A new security desk is now located at the main entry on the north side of the building. Here's what to expect upon entering the building:

  • Visitors will be greeted by a security specialist. You will be asked for a valid ID and the specialist will begin the check-in process.
  • Once completed, you will receive a visitor sticker badge that must be worn at all times while in the building.
  • You will then proceed to the x-ray machine to place any belongings to be scanned and proceed through the metal detector.  At this point you will be free to drop off or collect approved plans at the BZS counter, as you do now. 

 The security desk will be occupied during the normal business hours of the building.

 

###

item.title: PHISHING EMAIL FROM BZS-PLEASE DELETE
item.description:
PHISHING EMAIL NOTICE:

2025 Combined Development Related Fee Schedule ref::#5606

Please delete the above titled email requesting review of documents from a Building and Zoning Services employee, as it is fraudulent.

In an effort to curb these types of mails, contact your email provider as they may use an email verification technology known as DMARC. This allows recipients of such emails to be able to tell if it is an official email from a real Columbus.gov email account or not. You will need to turn on DMARC verification with your email provider to take advantage of the technology. This should allow your email security filtering software to automatically reject such malicious messages claiming to be from the city.

We apologize for any inconvenience.

 

###

item.title: Additional applications added to Citizens Access Portal
item.description:
NOTICE

ADDITIONAL APPLICATIONS ADDED TO CITIZENS ACCESS PORTAL

In the past year, the Department of Building and Zoning Services  has increased the types of records available for application through our Citizen Access Portal. The online applications available for all types of structures (one-three dwelling units, multi-unit residential and commercial) include:

  • Addition
  • Alteration
  • Damage
  • Deck, Patio
  • Fence, Retaining Wall
  • New Structure
  • Swimming Pool
  • Parking Lot permits (multi-family and commercial)
  • Plans Examination (only, does not result in a building permit)
  • Fire Alarm
  • Fire Suppression
  • Roof, Siding, Windows and Doors replacement permits are also available for commercial structures.

The YouTube playlist linked below includes tutorial videos that cover some aspects of Citizen Access, including how to create an account and associate a registration.

https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLDzGbueVklj0Y9uFxFlpeP3WJpbO8cvMh

Before submitting plans online for review, you should be familiar with our submission standards and aware that drawings cannot be added after submission, unless the plans examiner issues a corrections letter. Bear in mind, revisions to approved plans require a new Plans Revision record to be created through Citizen Access, you do not upload the plans to the approved building record.

###

item.title: EFFECTIVE TODAY- BUILDING SERVICES FEE INCREASE
item.description:
NOTICE

EFFECTIVE TODAY

**REMINDER: BUILDING SERVICES FEES TO INCREASE

Effective Monday, January 13, 2025, Building Services fees will increase. The new fees are calculated using the 2025 Combined Development Related Fee Schedule.  

Some of the revisions in the 2025 Combined Development Related Fee Schedule include:

  • 1, 2, and 3 Family Dwelling Building Permit Fees
    • Alterations/Accessory Structures with 2 inspections
      • $350.00
    • Mechanical, Electrical and Plumbing with 2 inspections
      • $250.00
    • Fence with 2 inspections
      • $300.00
  • Commercial/Mixed Use and Multi-Family Building Permit Fees
    • New Construction, Additions, Alterations and Accessory Structures including Swimming Pools with 2 inspections
      • $650.00 for the first 1,000 square feet. $6.00 for each 10 gross square feet or portion thereof after the initial 1,000 square feet
      • Maximum fee is $500,000
    • Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing with 2 inspections
      • $500.00 with 1 inspection
      • $650.00 with 2 inspection
  • Site Engineering Fees
    • Final site compliance new application
      • $600.00

To view and download the new fee schedule visit https://www.columbus.gov/Business-Development/Building-Zoning-Services/Documents-Forms

If you have any questions, please send an email to: FAManly-Spain@columbus.gov

item.title: Building and Zoning Services is now responsible for private water and fire service inspections for underground lines
item.description:
Building and Zoning Services is now responsible for private water and fire service inspections for underground lines

The Department of Building and Zoning Services is now responsible for private water and fire service inspections for underground lines between the meter and/or after the backflow preventer and the structure based on the WSP.  Additional questions may be directed to the plumbing inspection section at plumbinginfo@columbus.gov.

To schedule an inspection you will first need to follow these steps to purchase a water service record through the Citizen Access Portal.

  • Create an account and log in, then associate your City of Columbus registration number to your account.
  • Under building, click purchase permit or inspection trip.
  • Select the appropriate registration and follow the steps to create a water service record.
  • After the record is paid for and issued inspections can be scheduled through Citizen Access or the automated inspection scheduling line for Building and Zoning Services.
  • Similar to other Building and Zoning Services permits the water service records are issued with a set number of inspection trips.
    • Each time an inspector visits the site a trip is debited from the record.
    • When the balance of trips available is zero a trip will need to be purchased before an inspection can be scheduled.

The YouTube playlist linked below provides tutorial videos on some aspects of Citizen Access including how to create an account, associate a registration to an account, and schedule an inspection.

https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLDzGbueVklj0Y9uFxFlpeP3WJpbO8cvMh

item.title: Fire Suppression and Fire Alarm applications may be submitted online
item.description:
Fire Suppression and Fire Alarm plans may be submitted online

The Department of Building and Zoning Services is pleased to announce the availability of online plan submissions for Fire Suppression and Fire Alarm applications.  You can submit documents through our Citizen Access Portal on the City’s website.  Citizen Access is a web-based solution that lets customers initiate and complete the plan submission, review and approval process online, rather than submitting paper plans to our office.

You will need to first create an account if you don’t already have one.  Click on the links below for instructions.

To access Citizen Access:

  • Go to Columbus.gov;
  • Choose Business & Development;
  • Choose Building & Zoning;

Click on the red Citizen Access Portal button.

You may also find the following information useful to help create your account.

creating-an-account-user-manual.pdf

https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLDzGbueVklj0Y9uFxFlpeP3WJpbO8cvMh

Please be sure to name the files, per the instructions on page 4 of the Submission Standards.  The Submission Standards can also be found in the portal.

submission-standards-electronic-review-for-building-permits2024.pdf

###

item.title: Spam notice from Building and Zoning Services
item.description:
NOTICE

**SPAM NOTICE NOT FROM BUILDING AND ZONING SERVICES**

The Department of Building and Zoning Services did NOT send out a recent  email stating "Code Violation Notice". It is SPAM.  Please do not click on any links or enter any credentials.  

The city of Columbus uses an email verification technology known as DMARC.  This allows recipients of such emails to be able to tell if it is an official email from a real Columbus.gov email account or not. You will need to turn on DMARC verification with your email provider to take advantage of the technology. This should allow your email security filtering software to automatically reject such malicious messages from claiming to be from the City.

We apologize for any inconvenience these fake emails may have caused. 

###

item.title: SPAM/FAKE EMAILS-NOT FROM THE CITY OF COLUMBUS
item.description:
**SPAM NOTICE NOT FROM BUILDING AND ZONING SERVICES**

The Department of Building and Zoning Services did NOT send out a recent  email stating "Code Violation Notice". It is SPAM.  Please do not click on any links or enter any credentials.  BZS sent out an email yesterday to bring awareness to the fake violation notice.

According to the city's technology department, the original email came from gemrnining.[com], which is NOT affiliated with the City. We use an email verification technology known as DMARC.  This allows recipients of such emails to be able to tell if it is an official email from a real Columbus.gov email account or not. You will need to turn on DMARC verification with your email provider to take advantage of the technology. This should allow your email security filtering software to automatically reject such malicious messages from claiming to be from the City.

We apologize for any inconvenience these fake emails may have caused.

item.title: Phishing email notice-Code Violation Notice ref. #0764542.PDF
item.description:
Phishing Email Notice

It has come to our attention that Building and Zoning Services customers have been receiving an email with the subject line "Code Violation Notice." Example below.  Please be advised that this is a phishing email and is NOT an email from the City of Columbus or the Department of Building and Zoning Services. Please DO NOT click any links or enter any credentials. You should also use the "Report Phish" options provided by your email carrier.

We apologize for any inconvenience.

Contact: Cynthia Rickman, Department of Building and Zoning Services,614-724-1621.
